verdict.rationale: Scheduled data refreshes are a plausible capability for a bank-data API, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows one-off refresh completion webhooks and a use-case mention of 'monitoring', not any documented way for users to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. A community remark about 'daily pulls' describes a data-freshness limit, not a user-configurable schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
